name: Keagan Máistirúin
source:
Little is known of Keagan's past—almost certainly by his own design—but what is known is that he distinguished himself during the War of the Courts as someone with a knack for intrigue and espionage. Due to this talent, he quickly scaled the ranks of the Seelie Court until he reached his current position: Máistirúin, or Master of Secrets. With his keen senses and control of the will-o-wisps, little happens in Tír na nÓg without his knowledge. If you ever need to find him, you should probably check next to the Queen of the Seelie Court, Aífe, as they are close confidants.

Keagan's position at court likewise means he is at the centre of numerous rumours. Some whisper that he may have been involved in Aífe's crowning, while others allude to a past connection with a Seelie noble that didn't end well. Regardless, there is more beneath the surface of this mysterious man than first meets the eye. Do you dare dive deeper?

[From [url=https://moiraimyths.com/tgp]official website[/url]]
